Consider the objective function $R(	heta) $$=$$  rac{1}{1000}\sum_{i=1}**{3}|x_i - 	heta|$. This function is a scaled version of the sum of absolute deviations from $	heta$. To minimize this function, think about the properties of the median in a dataset.

**Hint 2:**
The sum of absolute deviations from a point is minimized when that point is the median of the dataset. For the data points {1, $$6$$, 17}, identify the median value, as this will minimize the objective function $R(	heta)$.
